rights.fileTitle: File:Slave routes of the Ethiopian Empire.jpg

photo.caption: Slave trade routes through Ethiopia
photo.description: Slave trade routes of historical Ethiopia. Slaves from the Gumuz, Oromia and Sidama regions were brought to the Christian Highlands controlled by the Solomonic Dynasty and exported through Massawa and Tajoura natural ports.
